chunks: And your Lord would not destroy the cities until He sends to their mother city a messenger reciting to them Our verses. And We would not destroy the cities except while their people were wrongdoers.
ai.seo_question: Why does God destroy cities according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Anbiya underscores the principle of divine justice (Adl), affirming that punishment is never arbitrary but follows the clear presentation of truth through a messenger. It highlights that the destruction of civilizations is a direct consequence of their own oppression (Zulm) after being given ample opportunity to heed the divine signs, a concept deeply linked to the Shia understanding of theodicy and the role of Prophets as warners.
